output.answer: Capital One Financial had approximately 76,300 employees (whom it calls “associates”) worldwide as of December 31, 2025, per its fiscal 2025 Form 10-K — the most recent official headcount. Third-party estimates put the figure slightly higher, at about 77,500 as of September 30, 2026, reflecting continued hiring after the Discover acquisition (closed May 2025) added roughly 23,700 employees during 2025. So as of today, Capital One has roughly 76,000–78,000 employees.
caveats: The most recent official, company-disclosed headcount is ~76,300 as of December 31, 2025 (10-K); the ~77,500 figure for September 30, 2026 is a third-party estimate, not a company filing.
Capital One's Q3 2026 Form 10-Q does not disclose a headcount figure, so no more recent primary-source number exists as of 2026-11-11.
